Game Overview

Paper Craft Wars is a strategy game built around lead your chosen race to victory in this fast-paced RTS/RPG hybrid. Master tactical maneuvers, capture enemy bases, and defend your kingdom in a world of unique paper-crafted aesthetics. With magical skills and achievements to unlock, Paper Craft Wars is a strategic adventure that unfolds in captivating creativity.
